$comment: The only identifiers a run knows (D69). Ingress builds the id decision questions, their options and the label fallback from this file; nothing per field is hardcoded. `key` order must match KNOWN_ID_KEYS in src/types/core.ts (a test checks it). `pattern` finds candidate values in the thread (JavaScript regex source, flags gi); `normalise` is applied to a candidate before it is offered and stored. A field with `options` is a choice over those options instead, matched through their aliases. `labels` are the template labels the fallback reads as `<label>: <value>`, longest match first.

fields.description: The country of the customer's account.
fields.question: Which country does the message say the customer is in? Pick none if it does not say.

fields.description: The customer's phone number. It may carry a country prefix such as +44 or +971.
fields.question: Which value in the message is the customer's phone number? Pick none if the message gives no phone number.

fields.description: The user's id in the Aspora app (a UUID). The same value is harbor account_forms.external_user_ref.
fields.question: Which value in the message is the user's Aspora user id? Pick none if the message does not give one.

fields.description: The SSFB customer_id (a UUID, harbor customer.customer_id). Not the CIF id.
fields.question: Which value in the message is the SSFB customer id? It is not the CIF id. Pick none if the message does not give one.

fields.description: The SSFB account form id (a UUID, harbor account_forms.form_id; also the NSTP application id and the workflow reference id).
fields.question: Which value in the message is the account form id (also called form id or NSTP application id)? Pick none if the message does not give one.

fields.description: The SSFB account_id (a UUID, rhythm customer_account_mappings.account_id). Not the bank account number.
fields.question: Which value in the message is the SSFB account id? It is a UUID, not the bank account number. Pick none if the message does not give one.
